en: Potential is the past of the act – of any act, whether it be nestled in some long-ago epoch, on the point of taking place right now, or lying far in the future. It is the non-chronological antecedent of any dateable event. It plays out behind all that which attains the rank of the present. It precedes the ‘now’ as such. Thus the

is the fulcrum of temporality. If this expression were not supremely ambiguous, it could simply be termed ‘originary time’. This ‘before’, which does not correspond to anything real, is the red thread through and around the weft of becoming; it is the constant backdrop to the yesterday, today and tomorrow on the calendar; it delineates the horizon against which the
succession of actualities stand out. The potential past exhibits
, permanent and impossible to segment, within whose terms ‘all change in phenomena’ must be thought. Reciprocally, time-as-a-whole does not appear except in the form of the
: a ‘past’ because it is always anterior to that which on each occasion falls

time; but ‘unrealised’ because if it were gradually enacted then it would be possible to subdivide it into chronological phases or periods, thus itself also assuming the aspect of a phenomenon taking place within time.
zh: 潜能是实现的过去——任何实现的过去，无论它栖身于某个久远时代，正在此刻发生，还是处于遥远未来。它是一切可标定日期之事件的非年代前项，活动于一切取得当下地位之物的背后；它先于作为‘现在’的现在。因此，潜能过去是时间性的支点。如果这个表达不是极度含混，我们大可以直接称它为‘本源时间’（originary time）。这个并不对应任何现实之物的‘之前’，是贯穿生成之经纬的红线；是历法上昨天、今天和明天的恒常背景；它勾勒出一连串现实性从中凸显的视域。潜能过去展示了作为整体的时间：它恒久而不可分割，‘现象中的一切变化’都必须在它的范围内得到思考。反过来，作为整体的时间只以未实现过去的形式出现：它之所以是‘过去’，是因为它总先于每次落入时间之中的东西；它之所以‘未实现’，则是因为如果它被逐步付诸实现，就可以被细分为年代阶段或时期，从而自身也会呈现为时间内发生的一种现象。

en: Temporality is characterised by the

. Such a formula demands careful consideration. We do not, of course, mean to say that the events already stashed in the archives are more important in organising the experience of time than are the events of today or the near future. The supremacy of the past derives, rather, from its

: on the one hand, a collection of accomplished facts, on the other a potential that can never be actualised. The past is the only dimension of becoming that has a non-chronological double, or, if we prefer, a
. Only the ‘back then’ is not limited to a mass of determinate contents but also appears as an autonomous
(the past-form) and a pure
(the horizon of anteriority). The present and the future are always empirical, since they are indissolubly attached to one or several concrete

: hypothetical in the first case, prefigured in the second. We cannot speak of a non-chronological principle of the present or future. Conversely, it is legitimate to distinguish between the empirical past and the past in general, between former actualities and the dateless ‘before’. Thus it was opportune, indeed necessary, to point out the mountain-ridge
that divides the memory of words spoken years ago from the memory of the language faculty.
zh: 时间性的特征，是过去具有首要地位。这个公式需要谨慎理解。当然，我们不是说，已经收藏在档案中的事件，比今天或不久将来的事件更能主导时间经验的组织。过去的优势反而来自它的双重性：一方面，它是已完成事实的集合；另一方面，它是永远无法被实现的潜能。过去是生成中唯一拥有非年代复本——或者说，拥有一个先验的另我（transcendental alter ego）——的维度。只有‘那时’不局限于一团确定内容，还作为自主形式——过去形式——和纯粹视域——在先性视域——出现。当下和未来始终是经验性的，因为它们不可分割地依附于一个或若干具体实现：前者是实际发生的，后者是预先描画的。我们无法谈论当下或未来的非年代原则。相反，区分经验过去与一般过去、从前的现实性与没有日期的‘之前’，是正当的。因此，我们指出那条把对多年前所说之词的记忆同对语言官能的记忆分隔开的山脊，既恰当又必要。
body.review: 校订疑点 S4：英文把当下的实现写作 hypothetical；译文沿用‘实际发生的’，与前后文保持一致，待其他版本复核。

en: The potential past is

. It coexists with the events and actions that were, are, and will be. Each instant of becoming entails the partnership – but also the irreparable separation – between non-actuality and presence, the indefinite ‘back then’ and the ‘now’ crowded with events. All events – May 1968, some obscure episode of our adolescence, Müntzer’s speech against Luther … – intersect, while they are really taking place, with the non-chronological past into which potential congeals. When we are talking about potential with regard to an ensemble of events on which the sun has now set, it appears as the (pure)
(empirical)
. When it is considered in terms of an act that is still underway, for example the essay on historical time that I am writing, then the faculties to which it is correlated instead constitute
. And lastly: with respect to the aleatory labours and the uncertain pleasures that stud the future, labour-power and the disposition towards pleasure
be something
, something on which it
be necessary to cast a retrospective gaze. In this case, labour-power and the disposition towards pleasure amount to

. Such a schema does, perhaps, favour the intuitive representation as to the pre-eminent role that the ‘back then’ plays in the articulation of temporality. But this is not, of course, devoid of its own problems. As long as we content ourselves with underlining the pervasiveness of the potential past, it appears to accompany the three empirical times as an external attachment or uninfluential counterpoint. On the one hand, this presupposes these three times without asking too much about their formation and structure; on

the other, it sets down an incomputable ‘before’ adjacent to each of them. This is simply lazy, and demands a sharp correction. As we shall see, the prerogative of pervasiveness is the static reflection of a tangle of rather more decisive relations.
zh: 潜能过去无所不在。它同曾经发生、正在发生和将要发生的事件与行动共存。生成的每个瞬间，都包含非现实性与在场、不确定的‘那时’与挤满事件的‘现在’之间的结伴，也包含它们不可弥合的分离。所有事件——1968年五月、我们青春期某段不为人知的插曲、闵采尔反对路德的演说……——在实际发生之际，都同潜能凝结而成的非年代过去交叉。当我们针对一组已经落幕的事件谈论潜能时，它表现为（经验）过去的（纯粹）过去。当我们针对一项仍在进行的行动考察潜能时——例如我正在撰写的这篇历史时间论——同该行动相关的官能便构成当下的过去。最后，对于散布在未来的偶然劳动与不确定快乐，劳动力和享受快感的禀赋将成为某种在先之物，成为必须回顾之物。在这个情形中，劳动力和享受快感的禀赋就是未来的过去。这个图式或许有助于我们直观表象‘那时’在分节时间性时所起的卓越作用。但它当然并非没有自身问题。如果我们只满足于强调潜能过去的无所不在，它就显得只是作为外在附着或不起作用的对位，伴随三个经验时间。一方面，这样做预设了三个时间，却没有充分追问它们的形成与结构；另一方面，它在每个时间旁边安放一个无法计算的‘之前’。这不过是思想上的懒惰，需要明确纠正。我们将会看到，无所不在这一特权，只是一团更具决定性关系的静态映像。

en: The potential past is

. That is, it contributes to determining the various regions into which we usually divide the sequence of chronology: the present, the (dateable) past, and the future. It is not limited to intersecting these three empirical times, but also plays an important role in their genesis. More generally, it establishes and preserves the
of becoming, of each segment or interstice of becoming.
zh: 潜能过去具有生产性。也就是说，它参与规定我们通常用来划分年代序列的各个区域：当下、（可标定日期的）过去和未来。它不仅同这三个经验时间交叉，而且在它们的生成中发挥重要作用。更一般地说，它建立并维持生成的历史性，维持生成每一个片段或间隙的历史性。

en: When we examine the concept of the

and the meaning of the adverb ‘now’ in the light of this potential past, its productivity becomes sharply apparent. It suffices, here, to recall the results of an analysis we previously developed at length. The ‘now’ is characterised by an essential
. Only that which comes
can be called ‘actual’. I repeat: not

a myriad of other now-faded actualities, but after the not-now potential. An act of speech establishes the present and makes it dovetail with its own unrepeatable execution, precisely because it leaves behind the perennial latency of the language faculty; that is, because it waves goodbye to a past (one not recorded in the calendar) in which there was only ‘the possibility of language’ (Benveniste).

children: The ‘now’ has the character of an ‘after’

en: . But the ‘after’ is wholly dependent on its ‘before’. We must then conclude that the ‘now’ exists only in relation to the potential past. Or rather, that the potential past, far from accompanying an already-given present in a parasitical fashion, instead contributes to defining its salient traits.
zh: 当我们借助潜能过去来考察当下概念与‘现在’这一副词的含义时，它的生产性便鲜明地显露出来。这里，只需回顾我们此前已经详细展开的分析结果。‘现在’具有一种本质的在后性。只有处于某物之后的东西，才能被称为‘现实的’。我再说一遍：不是在无数已经消逝的现实性之后，而是在潜在的非现在之后。言说行动之所以确立当下，使当下同自身不可重复的实行严丝合缝，恰恰是因为它把语言官能的恒久潜伏抛在身后；也就是说，因为它告别了一个只有‘语言之可能性’（本维尼斯特）的过去——一个没有记录在历法中的过去。‘现在’具有‘之后’的性质。但这个‘之后’完全依赖于它的‘之前’。因此我们必须得出结论：‘现在’只在同潜能过去的关系中存在。更确切地说，潜能过去并非以寄生方式伴随一个预先给定的当下，而是参与规定当下的显著特征。

en: There is more. Potential and the act are a ‘before’ and an ‘after’. But – here is the complication – they are an always-simultaneous ‘before’ and ‘after’. As we have seen, we must designate the nexus between them in terms of the concomitance of the diachronous. What does this simultaneity imply? The instant that I am living resembles a field of forces in tension, since it comprises both a posterior pole (the act) and an anterior one (potential): they both constipate and lacerate it. As a consequence, the instant that I am living does not at all coincide with the ‘now’: the apparent synonymy conceals a discrepancy. If we were to draw an equals sign between the concrete
and the act, actuality, the ‘now’, then we would only be grasping one of the two simultaneous aspects; that is, only one part or one aspect of … the concrete

. A terminological distinction is indispensible here. The instant that I am living – understood as the instant in which the simultaneity between act and potential, spoken word and language faculty, particular performance of labour and labour-power, takes place – will from now onward be indicated with the epithet
. Actuality in the proper sense of the word will instead be termed the
. To be sure, the historical moment is nothing other than the present understood in its genesis: an ‘after’ inseparable from the ‘before’, that is.
zh: 还不止如此。潜能与实现是‘先’与‘后’。但问题的复杂之处在于：它们是永远同时存在的‘先’与‘后’。正如我们所见，必须以历时之物的同时性来指称二者间的联系。这种同时性意味着什么？我正在生活的瞬间仿佛一个张力场，因为它既包含在后的一极——实现，也包含在先的一极——潜能；二者既挤压这个瞬间，也撕裂它。因此，我正在生活的瞬间绝不等同于‘现在’：表面上的同义掩盖着差异。如果我们在具体的此时此地与实现、现实性、‘现在’之间画上等号，就只把握了两个同时方面之一；也就是说，只把握了具体此时此地的一部分或一个侧面。这里必须作出术语区分。从现在开始，我将把正在生活的瞬间——理解为实现与潜能、说出的词与语言官能、具体劳动实行与劳动力之间的同时性得以发生的瞬间——称作历史时刻（historical moment）。严格意义上的现实性则称作当下。可以肯定，历史时刻无非是从其生成角度来理解的当下：即一个同‘之前’不可分割的‘之后’。

en: . In coining the phrase ‘contemporaneity of the non-contemporary’,
Ernst Bloch usually meant the survival of primitive mentalities and antiquated customs

even within fully developed capitalist society: such as the barter economy operating side-by-side with the International Monetary Fund, or Chinese immigrants in California who maintain their traditional family structure despite also working in the software industry. Yet it is here necessary to introduce a more radical meaning of this expression. We should understand

to mean, first of all, the coexistence of the faculty and the execution, the ‘before’-potential and the ‘after’-act, the non-chronological past and the determinate present, which characterises each historical moment. Since the simplest cell of temporality consists of two diachronous elements, it has a hybrid – or better,
nature. The contemporaneity of the non-contemporary is originally expressed in the fact that the immediate and indivisible

is not only perceived but also remembered while it is being lived. If we were not familiar with this fundamental anachronism, the fulcrum of any historical moment, we could not be alert to the countless empirical anachronisms apparent within a particular historical moment (the barter economy, the stubborn traditionalism of the software-producing Chinese family, etc.). It is true enough that capitalism itself foments the contemporaneity of the non-contemporary. But this is not so much a matter of the coexistence of technology and ancestral superstitions, as the litany repeated throughout the decades would have it. Rather, the crucial point lies in the theatrical portrayal of the plot of act and potential, the indefinite ‘back then’ and the dateable ‘now’. Mature capitalism, as we shall see in detail in the third part of this book, is the epoch in which the radical anachronism on which the historicity of experience itself depends comes to the surface, brought into relief as a most concrete phenomenon.
zh: 释论。恩斯特·布洛赫创造‘非同时者的同时代性’（contemporaneity of the non-contemporary）

这一短语时，通常指原始心态和陈旧习俗即便在充分发展的资本主义社会中仍然存续：例如，以物易物经济与国际货币基金组织并行运作，或加利福尼亚的华人移民在软件行业工作的同时仍维持传统家庭结构。不过，这里有必要赋予这个表达一种更为根本的含义。首先应当把非同时者的同时代性理解为官能与实行、‘之前’—潜能与‘之后’—实现、非年代过去与确定当下的共存；这种共存刻画每一个历史时刻。由于时间性的最简单细胞由两个历时要素组成，它便具有混合的——更准确地说，时代错置的——性质。非同时者的同时代性最初表现于这个事实：直接且不可分割的此时此地在被亲历时，不仅被知觉，也被记住。如果我们不熟悉这一构成任何历史时刻之支点的根本时代错置，就无法察觉某一特定历史时刻中显现的无数经验性时代错置——以物易物经济、从事软件生产的华人家庭所固守的传统主义等等。资本主义本身确实助长非同时者的同时代性。但关键与其说是几十年来老生常谈的技术与祖传迷信并存，不如说是实现与潜能、不确定的‘那时’与可标定日期的‘现在’这出情节被搬上舞台。成熟资本主义——正如本书第三部分将详细说明——是一个这样的时代：经验的历史性本身所依赖的根本时代错置浮出表面，并作为极其具体的现象被凸显出来。

en: The eminent requisites of the historical moment are its
and its

. We will examine each in separation, but with one proviso: there is an iron bond of reciprocity between them. Since the single historical moment is composed of an anterior and a posterior pole, it offers a miniaturised vision of the two directions in which any diachronous relation plays out: forward and backward. The divarication of the

into a ‘before’ and ‘an ‘after’ establishes both a regressive (or retrospective) orientation, from the ‘after’ towards the ‘before’, and a progressive (or prefigurative) one, from the ‘before’ towards the ‘after’. It is on the basis of these two complementary orientations that the historical moment on each occasion seems its own precursor and successor. Let us now turn to the second requisite. The historical moment is

. Incomplete, lacking. Nestling within it is an unrealised core: potential, the non-chronological ‘past’. Moreover, there is history precisely and only because non-actuality is wedged within presence, such as to constitute the blank space (or undefined value) of the instant that I am living. The faculty is never itself accomplished through the sum of its individual executions; the world-context remains amorphous and potential, whatever the facts that populate it; the not-now never transforms into a ‘now’. The faculty, world and not-now hold open a
within the instant. And this lacuna requires
. But what kind of filling can the historical moment hope to offer – even indirectly – when it is itself irredeemably unsaturated?
zh: 历史时刻最突出的两个条件，是它的双向性与未完成性。我们将分别考察二者，但须先说明：它们之间存在牢不可破的相互依存关系。单一历史时刻由在先与在后两极组成，因此以缩微形式展示任何历时关系展开的两个方向：向前与向后。此时此地分叉为‘之前’与‘之后’，既确立一种从‘之后’朝向‘之前’的回退性——或回顾性——取向，也确立一种从‘之前’朝向‘之后’的前进性——或预示性——取向。正是在这两个互补取向的基础上，每个历史时刻才显得既是自己的先驱，也是自己的后继。现在转向第二项条件。历史时刻未被充满，它不完整、有所欠缺。一个未实现的核心栖身其中：潜能，即非年代的‘过去’。而且，恰恰因为、也唯有因为非现实性楔入在场，构成我正在生活的瞬间之空白空间——或未定值——历史才存在。官能本身永远不会通过其各项实行的总和而完成；无论有多少事实充斥其中，世界—语境仍保持无定形与潜在状态；非现在永远不会转化为‘现在’。官能、世界与非现在使瞬间之内保持一道缺口。这道缺口要求被填补。但历史时刻自身既然无可挽回地未被充满，它又能希望提供何种填补——哪怕只是间接提供？

en: The two requisites are independent, or better, symbiotic. Neither only dual-directional or only incomplete, the historical moment is, rather, dual-directional in its incompleteness and incomplete in its dual directionality.
Both the diachronous orientations inherent within the

are full of lacunae. The regressive axis, from the ‘after’-act towards the ‘before’-potential, leaves a blank space; the progressive axis, from the ‘before’-potential towards the ‘after’-act, starts out from an indeterminate and unrealisable premise which the posterior pole could not possibly fulfil. The search for the filling – as for the lacuna – is also dual-directional. That is, it also plays out both forward and backward. We explicate the instant of saturation by extending our retrospection (‘after’ → ‘before’) and prefiguration (‘before’ → ‘after’)

children: beyond the confines of the single historical moment

en: , in the direction of what preceded it in time and what will follow it in time. It this thus an extrinsic saturation: the unrealised core of the instant that I am living directs this instant towards other instants that have already been or are still to be lived. The regressive filling of the lacuna is wholly the same as the
(empirical)
; the progressive filling is nothing other than the
zh: 这两个条件并非彼此独立，更准确地说，它们共生。历史时刻既非只有双向性，也非只有未完成性；它是在未完成中具有双向性，也在双向性中未完成。此时此地内在的两个历时取向都布满缺口。从‘之后’—实现朝向‘之前’—潜能的回退轴线留下一处空白；从‘之前’—潜能朝向‘之后’—实现的前进轴线，则从一个不确定且无法实现的前提出发，而在后的一极绝不可能使这个前提得到满足。对填补之物的寻找，同缺口本身一样也是双向的，也就是说，它既向前也向后展开。我们把回顾（‘之后’→‘之前’）和预示（‘之前’→‘之后’）延伸到单一历史时刻的边界之外，朝向时间上先于它和后于它的东西，以此展开对填补这一空缺的寻求。因此，这是一种外在的饱和：我正在生活的瞬间之未实现核心，把这个瞬间导向其他已经生活过或尚待生活的瞬间。对缺口的回退性填补，完全等同于（经验）过去的建构；前进性填补，则无非是未来的建构。
body.review: 校订疑点 S5：英文为 independent, or better, symbiotic；结合前段的相互依存关系，译文沿用‘并非彼此独立’。本段 instant of saturation 也可能有排印问题，暂按‘寻求填补空缺’解释。

en: The historical moment stipulates relations of affinity or difference with regard to multiple past events (the Paris Commune, a text by André Breton, some bitter love affair, etc.), in virtue of its characteristic retrospective orientation: ‘after’ → ‘before’. The

identifies its own antecedents, picking out a myriad of concrete historiographical ‘back thens’, because its texture already embodies a non-chronological ‘back then’. The starting point in the construction of any vivid ‘once upon a time’ is the posteriority of the act with respect to the concomitant potential. The ‘after’, the phrase that I am uttering, stretches back towards the ‘before’, the language faculty. But this antecedent is unsaturated and indefinite: certainly,

it does not constitute a solid state of affairs that we could stop to look at. In order to fill in the undefined value of the historical moment, retrospection turns to other former actualities. Thus it reaches out for the empirical past, using it as an emblem and ersatz version of the potential past. The memory of speeches and labours stashed away in the archive of time surreptitiously articulates the contemporary experience of the capacity-to-speak and labour-power. An ensemble of more or less remote past events (the Commune, the surrealist’s text, etc.) is called upon to incarnate the potential concealed within the
. As such, today’s potential is dressed up in the equivocal clothes of a tradition or example. In exchange, the traditions and examples which the
uses as its mirror maintain an aura of unresolved virtuality.
zh: 历史时刻凭借其特有的回顾取向——‘之后’→‘之前’——同过去的多重事件建立相似或差异关系，例如巴黎公社、安德烈·布勒东的一篇文字、某段痛苦恋情等等。此时此地之所以识别自身的前项，从历史编纂意义上的无数具体‘那时’中加以挑选，是因为它的纹理本身已经体现一个非年代的‘那时’。建构任何鲜活‘很久以前’的起点，都是实现相对于共存潜能的在后性。‘之后’——我正在说出的句子——向后伸展，指向‘之前’——语言官能。但这个前项尚未饱和且并不确定；它当然不构成一个可供我们停下来观察的坚实事态。为了填补历史时刻的未定值，回顾转向其他从前的现实性。它因而伸向经验过去，把后者用作潜能过去的标志和替代版本。收藏于时间档案中的言说与劳动之记忆，暗中分节着当下对言说能力和劳动力的经验。一组或远或近的过去事件——公社、超现实主义者的文字等等——受召来体现隐匿于此时此地的潜能。这样，今天的潜能披上了传统或范例那含混的衣装。作为交换，被此时此地用作镜子的传统与范例，则保留着尚未消解的潜在性光晕。

en: The historical moment produces the future on account

of that same internal diachrony (separation into an anterior and posterior pole) which also allows it to access the empirical past. Yet in the case of the future, it is the progressive orientation ‘before’ → ‘after’ which prevails. The starting point in the prefiguration of anything desired or feared ‘still to come’ is the anteriority of potential with respect to the concomitant act. The ‘before’, labour-power, looks to the ‘after’: to the labour that is now underway. But the specific execution anchored in contextualised processes is not commensurable to the generic faculty. Far from using up potential, acts never commute it – even in part – into their own mode of existence, just as rational numbers never offer an adequate correspondent to the irrational number. The ‘after’ does not complete the ‘before’. In order to redeem the

, which is full of lacunae, the progressive orientation heads beyond its confines and opens up the future. Other ‘afters’, set in a chronological succession, portend the eventual filling-in of the blank space encapsulated within the historical moment: and yet they always postpone this anew. Prefiguration is thus applied to a jumble of actualities that are still to come, in the customary forms of conjecture and expectation. It is only in order to realise the (potential) past that we construct the future.
zh: 历史时刻之所以产生未来，依据的仍是那种也使它能够通向经验过去的内在历时性——即分离为在先与在后两极。不过，在未来这一情形中，占主导地位的是‘之前’→‘之后’的前进取向。预示任何我们渴望或畏惧而‘尚未来临’之物的起点，是潜能相对于共存实现的在先性。‘之前’——劳动力——望向‘之后’，望向眼下正在进行的劳动。但锚定在具体语境过程中的特定实行，同一般官能不可通约。实现非但不能耗尽潜能，甚至从未把它的一部分转换成自身的存在方式，正如有理数永远无法为无理数提供恰当对应。‘之后’不能完成‘之前’。为了补救布满缺口的此时此地，前进取向越出它的边界，开启未来。按年代次序排列的其他‘之后’，预示历史时刻所含空白最终会被填补，却又总是重新推迟这种填补。因此，预示以通常的猜测与期待形式，应用于一团尚未来临的现实性。我们建构未来，只是为了实现（潜能的）过去。

en: Retrospection and prefiguration risk collapsing into
. If I attribute the features of today’s potential to an act which took place in times past, then inevitably I will venerate this past act as an
charged with destiny, one on which I continue to depend. Equally, if I attribute the task of exhausting potential to a future act, then I am passing it off as the
towards which the whole of becoming is tending. Fetishism of the origin, in one case; fetishism of the end, in the other. This double

fetishistic illusion vanishes, however, when we understand that yesterday’s event (the presumed ‘origin’) and tomorrow’s event (the much-vaunted ‘end’) are themselves ‘afters’ linked to a dateless ‘before’; that is, when it becomes clear that these events are themselves inserted in unsaturated historical moments of their own. The lacuna is also present in the empirical past and in the future which were meant to fill it in. The former
, too, was a field of forces in tension in which the not-now coexisted with the ‘now’. At the
which we await with bated breath will, too, be dual-directional and incomplete. So in what does the relation between different historical moments consist? In their

: this being a prerogative which shares nothing in common with continuity or causal influence. The specularity of the filled-in and the empty. The potential and unrealised side of the instant I am now living demands saturation, retrospectively in past acts and prefiguratively in future acts. And yet this instant is itself also the object of prefigurations and retrospections: it was foreseen and will be remembered. So the different instants swap roles. As a definite actuality, the instant that I am living provides a progressive filling to the already-lived instant (or better, the lacuna within it) as well as a regressive filling to the instant that is still to be lived (to its undefined value).
zh: 回顾与预示都有沦为拜物教的危险。如果我把今天潜能的特征归给过去发生的一项实现，就必然会把这项过去实现奉为负载命运的起源，仿佛自己仍然依赖它。同样，如果我把穷尽潜能的任务归给一项未来实现，就会把它冒充为整个生成趋向的终点。一个情形是对起源的拜物教，另一个情形是对终点的拜物教。然而，一旦我们明白昨天的事件——被假定的‘起源’——和明天的事件——大受吹捧的‘终点’——本身也都是同无日期之‘之前’相联的‘之后’，这种双重拜物教幻象便会消失；也就是说，一旦清楚这些事件自身也嵌入各自未被充满的历史时刻，幻象便会消失。本来要填补缺口的经验过去与未来，自身也存在这道缺口。从前的此时此地同样是一个张力场，非现在在其中同‘现在’共存；而我们屏息等待的此时此地也将同样具有双向性和未完成性。那么，不同历史时刻之间的关系究竟是什么？在于它们的镜像性；这一特权同连续性或因果影响毫无共同之处，是已填满者与空缺者之间的镜像性。我此刻正在生活的瞬间，其潜在而未实现的一面要求得到饱和：在回顾方向上诉诸过去的实现，在预示方向上诉诸未来的实现。然而，这个瞬间自身也是预示与回顾的对象：它曾经被预见，将来会被记住。于是，不同瞬间交换角色。作为一种确定的现实性，我正在生活的瞬间为已经生活过的瞬间——更准确地说，为其中的缺口——提供前进性填补；同时也为尚待生活的瞬间——为它的未定值——提供回退性填补。
参见恩斯特·布洛赫《我们时代的遗产》第二部分（剑桥：Polity，2009年），以及《进步概念中的区分》（Differenzierung im Begriff Fortschritt，柏林：科学院，1956年）。

zh: 本雅明坚持必须‘救赎被压抑的过去’，这一点广为人知。他在这种过去中发现一个未实现、潜在且未被充满的方面，它不断要求在当下时刻中被重新接续并展开。‘只有这样一位历史书写者，才禀有在过去点燃希望火花的天赋：他确信，如果敌人获胜，甚至死者也不会安全。’（‘论历史的概念’，第六条）不过，如果忠实于本雅明的冲动与概念词汇，我们还应补充两点限定。第一，年代过去中的这个或那个经验事件之所以同当下时刻‘结成星丛’，恰恰是因为当下时刻自身把一般过去——潜能——包含为其内在构件之一。第二，或远或近的过去中已经成为事实的东西之所以显得仍保留某种未实现潜在性，恰恰是因为潜在性本身只作为曾经如此之物——‘早在那时’、τὸ τί ἦν εἶναι——而存在。本雅明所说‘辩证影像’的支点，是两类过去之间的关系：事实过去与非年代的——潜在、未实现的——过去。这确实是一种辩证关系，因为两项各自在一定程度上反映另一项，短暂地披上另一项的装束并代表它。
en: Benjamin’s insistence on the need to ‘redeem the suppressed past’ is well known. Within this past he located an unrealised, potential, unsaturated aspect which ever anew demands to be reprised and developed within the present moment. ‘The only writer of history with the gift of setting alight the sparks of hope in the past, is the one who is convinced of this: that not even the dead will be safe from the enemy, if he is victorious’ (‘On the Concept of History’, Thesis VI). Remaining faithful to Benjamin’s impulse and conceptual lexicon, we ought, however, to add two qualifications. Firstly: this or that empirical episode of the chronological past ‘enters into a constellation’ with the present moment

the present moment itself entails the past-in-general – potential – as one of its intrinsic components. Secondly: that which was a fact in a more or less distant past seems to retain a certain unrealised potentiality
potentiality in and of itself only exists as that which

, ‘already back then’, τὁ τἰ ἦν εἰναι. The fulcrum of the ‘dialectical image’ of which Benjamin speaks is the relation between the two types of past: factual past and non-chronological (potential, unrealised) past. A dialectical relation, indeed, since each of the two terms reflects the other to a certain degree, for a moment taking on its trappings and representing it.
